leads.summary: VibeTensor is a DPIIT-recognized Indian startup founded in 2025 that builds four live AI products: UpdataMind (career intelligence), IssueVista (GitHub issue prioritization for engineering teams), VibeMCP (MCP-based workflow automation) and Attestix (AI agent identity and compliance).
leads.hook: IssueVista's site says 'stop drowning in GitHub issues' and sells contributor insights and productivity analytics for engineering teams.
leads.angle_reason: Canopy's cross-file repo analysis is the closest match to VibeTensor's developer tooling, especially IssueVista's GitHub-focused analytics.

leads.summary: Vaanarayoo Technologies' GitHub org description is a profile-style tagline covering generative AI architecture, full-stack PHP/Node/React/WordPress work and cloud automation. No website text was available, so what the company builds for whom is unconfirmed.
leads.angle_reason: Their generative AI positioning is closest to MedVault's Gemini pipeline, though their stack is PHP/WordPress rather than Django.

leads.summary: ACE (Association of Computer Enthusiasts) is the technical society of VSIT, Vivekananda Institute of Professional Studies in Delhi, running workshops, hackathons and a magazine. Its GitHub projects are JavaScript/TypeScript web apps. It is a student society with no open role.
leads.hook: Its GitHub topics include monorepo and nx, with Astro, React and Firebase projects.
leads.angle_reason: Canopy's dependency and graph analysis fits an Nx monorepo of many JS/TS packages, though ACE is a student society rather than a hiring company.

leads.summary: Django India is a community of Django developers in India that runs meetups, workshops and webinars and supports open-source Django projects. It is not a product company, and its site says upcoming events are temporarily unavailable.
leads.hook: Its GitHub topics include django-rest-framework and docker-compose alongside good-first-issue, which points to an active contributor funnel.
leads.angle_reason: MedVault is a Django REST Framework backend with JWT auth and per-user isolation, the closest Django work to a Django community's projects.

leads.summary: Casual Office is an open-source, self-hosted Google Docs and Sheets alternative: a spreadsheet editor, a .docx editor and a PDF editor that open and save Office files in the browser with real-time co-editing, plus a Docker one-liner to self-host.
leads.hook: Your site says Casual Sheets saves .xlsx back byte-for-byte and the Docs editor passes 39/39 .docx round-trip fixtures.
leads.angle_reason: Casual Office parses and re-serializes OOXML and runs a formula engine, the same parse-and-analyze problem Canopy solves with tree-sitter across ten languages.

leads.summary: Widle is an Indian software agency that builds custom apps for clients and specializes in Retool development. Its GitHub org also has Flutter, Python and Rust repos.
leads.hook: Your Recent Projects list includes the Xaver Sports Retool app.
leads.angle_reason: Widle ships client-facing business apps, and MedVault is a complete client-facing app with a Django REST backend, JWT auth and per-user data isolation.
